scope: Successor gate required after v13 primary equal-cap contraction exhausted. It permits a renderer-tagged, non-color actual-core midpoint mask so only predicted inner-halo cap fragments that would replace prior actual-core physical-pixel support are discarded. Predicted core, lateral 2px inner annulus, side-only outer rim, 18/12/30 dash rhythm, source identities, thresholds, and actual-then-predicted color submission remain unchanged.

feasibility_conclusion.reason: The trajectory package knows continuous projected geometry but not the production MSAA/sample-resolved prior owner. Polygon or pixel-grid clipping would be an approximation and cannot distinguish actual core from actual halo, scene color, or partial sample coverage without expanding the contract.

trajectory_package_tagging: Keep frozen predicted coreCap=1.5px, innerCap=3.5px, outerCap=3.5px, dashOn=18px, dashOff=12px, period=30px, phase, centers, line width, route, and endpoint geometry.

Split each predicted inner-halo dash primitive into the unchanged central/lateral body and exact 2px start/end cap-annulus fragments only for tagging; their union must be byte-for-byte geometrically equivalent to the baseline inner-halo rectangle.

Add one flat per-vertex overlayMaskRole enum. All three vertices of a triangle must agree: PredictedInnerCap only for cap-annulus fragments, ActualRouteBodyCore only for continuous actual segment-core triangles, and None for predicted core/lateral inner/outer/endpoint plus actual halo/rim/ticks/endpoints/markers.
Retain the existing predicted dash halo semantic batch/token/source identity; splitting/tagging may not add a batch, token, probe, draw call, or change vertex ownership.
actual_core_mask_pipeline: Create an overlay-local non-color integer actual-core coverage attachment and a separate frozen single-sample GL_R8UI or GL_R32UI mask texture owned by ModernRenderer; clear to zero every frame and recreate on resize/context loss.

During the existing actual color submission, write mask value 1 only when uSubmissionTrackActual is true and overlayMaskRole is ActualRouteBodyCore; actual halo/rim/ticks/endpoints write zero. The mask attachment has blending disabled and the decision must not depend on HDR/RGB equality or capture instrumentation.

With MSAA, use an explicit integer any-sample/max resolve from the multisample mask into the frozen mask: one or more actual-core samples resolve to 1 and zero samples resolve to 0. Freeze/copy after actual completes and before predicted starts; never sample an attached render target and never rely on normalized-color averaging.

During predicted submission, discard a fragment before both color and ownership-token writes only when overlayMaskRole is PredictedInnerCap and the frozen actual-core mask at that physical pixel is positive.
Keep exactly two trajectory color draws and actual-then-predicted submission. The midpoint mask resolve/blit is non-color bookkeeping, not a reordered color draw or new product pass.
resulting_behavior: Actual core under a predicted inner-halo cap fragment remains the final color/owner at that pixel.
Predicted core still replaces actual core and remains yellow dominant; lateral inner halo and 2px lateral annulus still replace prior content as before.
Actual halo/rim, scene cloth, ball, cue, guide, and coincident deep-cyan scene color never activate the non-overwrite path.
The two repaired predicted silhouette probes and side-only outer rim remain unchanged.

allowed_production_files.allowed_symbols_or_regions: Predicted inner-halo cap-fragment decomposition/tag emission and renderer-only diagnostics; baseline cap dimensions and all source/semantic identities remain fixed.
One flat overlayMaskRole vertex enum/field for None, ActualRouteBodyCore, and PredictedInnerCap plus bounded diagnostics; no model, source probe, ownership algorithm, or authority changes.
Overlay-local actual-core mask target/freeze/resolve lifecycle, trajectory vertex attribute and shader mask predicate, and exact actual/predicted submission plumbing only.
Read-only frame metrics proving actual-core mask allocation/freeze/use and unchanged two-color-draw order; no public product option or exposure toggle.

forbidden_changes: No edits outside the four allowed production files and non-production CPU/static tests/validators/receipts; the prior v13 two-file allowlist is not silently amended.
No HDR/RGB/color-equality inference, alpha marker, scene-color heuristic, actual-halo substitution, stencil/depth workaround, or capture-only instrumentation dependency for actual-core detection.
No predicted core discard, lateral inner-halo discard, outer-rim discard caused by this mask, whole-cap unconditional removal, or suppression when the midpoint mask is zero.
No cap width, inner annulus, dash on/off/period/phase/center, route, centerline, offset, endpoint, tick, marker, camera, viewport, scene, asset, UI, or layout change.
No actual core/halo/rim width, overlap, join, marker, color, or geometry change and no retry of exhausted v12/v13 candidates.
No color-draw reorder, predicted-before-actual change, extra trajectory color draw, pass reorder, depth override, post-process repaint, or later-UI masking workaround.
No source ID/count/order/coordinate, semantic batch/token, ownership association/arbitration/connectivity/reason, threshold, final-LDR pairing, tone-map, or acceptance change.
No stale mask reuse, framebuffer feedback, unresolved MSAA aliasing, fail-open allocation/format/resize behavior, or mask sampling outside tagged cap fragments.
No product exposure flag, readiness, authorization, GPU execution, capture retry, machine/TA/targeted5/targeted11/formal68 claim, golden, M2, or Beta promotion from this design gate.

fixtures.requirement: Only predicted inner-halo start/end cap-annulus triangles use PredictedInnerCap; only continuous actual segment-core triangles use ActualRouteBodyCore; predicted core/lateral-inner/outer/endpoint and actual halo/rim/ticks/endpoints use None. Every triangle's three roles match.
Tagged cap fragments plus untagged inner body exactly reproduce baseline 1.5/3.5 cap geometry, 2px annulus, 18/12/30 rhythm, source IDs, tokens, batches, probes, and <=8192 budget.
Tagged cap + positive renderer-tagged actual-core mask discards before color and ownership writes, preserving prior actual-core color/token.
Actual inner/outer halo without actual core yields mask=0 and must not suppress a tagged predicted cap.
Cloth, ball, cue, guide, or arbitrary scene RGB equal/near the actual deep cyan with mask=0 must not suppress a tagged predicted cap.
Positive actual-core mask under an untagged predicted core does not discard; predicted yellow color/token remains final.
Positive actual-core mask under untagged lateral predicted inner halo does not discard; the lateral 2px annulus is preserved.
Tagged cap with a zero mask renders unchanged; no unconditional cap hole is permitted.
For 1x and 4x fixtures, any actual-core sample resolves to positive and zero actual-core samples resolve to zero; instrumentation on/off produces identical color and mask decisions.

Unallocated, wrong-size, wrong-format, framebuffer-incomplete, feedback-bound, or stale-frame mask prevents trajectory submission with an explicit error; it never blanket-discards or silently renders the fallback.
Standard and CVD CPU raster at [783,413], [892,491], and [940,525] each has an open predicted gap and actual-core area >=1.5 with largest8 >=2; halo pixels cannot substitute.

Algorithm 78 inherited visible IDs are monotonic, exact three repair IDs union to 81, and v11 player/elevated/overhead source and visible-ID digests/metrics do not regress; foreign/double/unowned remain zero.
[855,469] and [879,486] remain >=4.0, predicted yellow/side-only rim remain dominant, exactly two trajectory color draws remain actual then predicted, and mask freeze occurs strictly between them.

Resize/context loss/reinitialize clears and recreates both source and frozen mask targets; package texture count remains zero, renderer mask bytes/dimensions are reported, and existing performance thresholds remain unchanged.

required_cpu_and_static_negative_fixture.implementation_exit: All fourteen fixtures and existing renderer/ownership/telemetry suites must pass under frozen source and CPU binary hashes. This still does not authorize GPU capture or establish machine/TA acceptance.
